deviations.what: Button.ariaHasPopup (since UI5 1.84) is newer than 1.71 but kept for the 1:1 port on both Buttons - the app needs a UI5 release >= 1.84 to render it.
Link.ariaHasPopup (since UI5 1.86) is newer than 1.71 but kept for the 1:1 port - the app needs a UI5 release >= 1.86 to render it.

DatePicker.hideInput (since UI5 1.97) is newer than 1.71 but kept for the 1:1 port - the sample's central property (the picker input stays hidden, opened only via the anchor controls); openBy is also since 1.97, so the app needs a UI5 release >= 1.97 to render this sample's behavior.
